posts.name: chainsawrabbit
posts.cooked:
grysqrl:

My guess would be that painted minis will not be at GenCon, since KS orders which include painted minis were going to be delayed for several months.

It's not so much that painted miniatures are delayed, as it is that they are still on the original fulfillment timeline.

The first wave of Sentinel Tactics was originally scheduled to ship in December, the painted miniature wave in February or March of 2015, and the Maps & Minions wave in June or July 2015.  The first wave of Sentinel Tactics goodies are very ahead of schedule, a situation all but unheard of when dealing with Kickstarter rewards.

As far as we know, painted-minis wave is still on schedule.  I apologize for being overly nitpikcy about the language.
